$comment: TEST-003 functional-coverage manifest. Each framework capability that the CLI exposes must have a kit-based functional test (driving a real InteractiveSession via @robota-sdk/agent-framework/testing). The functional-coverage harness scan fails when a listed test is missing or does not use the harness. Add a row whenever you add a framework capability (see .agents/rules/testing-layering.md).

capabilities.description: The scriptedSession functional harness drives a real InteractiveSession (self-test / reference).
GOAL-001 autonomous objective loop: multi-turn pursuit, satisfied + max-iterations stop.
Denied tools are blocked end to end (side effect prevented, denial reported).
Resume restores a persisted conversation; fork restores context into a new session id.
Real recorded Qwen run drives goal pursuit to satisfied (real prompts + tool-use, replayed).
A composed /command runs through the real session command pipeline and returns its result.
Live preset persona/self-verification updates reach the REAL provider request (system-prompt SSOT) as a single, non-duplicated system message.
A background-task completion / scheduled fire injects an agent-wakeup turn that reaches the provider (FLOW-002/003); repeated wakes for one task id coalesce.
TERM-001: the session orchestrates a transport terminal handoff (suspend→fn→restore), restores on throw, is exclusive, and fast-fails when no interactive terminal is available.
TERM-003: /shell routes a one-shot command through the terminal handoff (suspend→spawn shell→restore), reports its exit code, and is unavailable with no interactive terminal.
TERM-004: /editor opens $EDITOR via the terminal handoff, captures the saved text round-trip, and is unavailable with no interactive terminal.
BEHAVIOR-2003: /keybindings ensures the TUI-owned file, opens its exact path through terminal handoff, and stays unavailable without an interactive terminal.
ARCH-014: a real InteractiveSession log externalizes a large response, and a second real session replays it byte-exactly without shifting the next response.
A discovered fork skill selects the child provider request model while preserving parent and agent defaults; inject model metadata is rejected before provider execution.
Strict skill authority metadata reaches a real session: disabled skills are hidden from the provider and model activation is refused; malformed flags prevent provider requests.
